results.query: NEC 690.41(B) PV dc ground-fault detector-interrupter GFDI requirement 30V 8A
results.snippet: PV system DC circuits that exceed 30V or 8A must be provided with ground-fault detector-interrupter (GFDI) protection [Sec. 690.41(B)].
